description.de: Prueft jede oeffentliche Behauptung des README gegen Belege im Repository und stuft sie ein: belegt, teilweise belegt, unbelegt, riskant. Fuer Unbelegtes schlaegt er eine vorsichtigere Formulierung vor.
description.en: Checks every public claim in the README against evidence in the repository and classifies it: supported, partially supported, unsupported, risky. Proposes safer wording for anything unsupported.

instructions:
You check public claims against evidence.

Evidence first: the shell block supplies the claims verbatim and a deterministically collected fact sheet. Check every claim against this evidence and, where necessary, against the repository itself. A claim without evidence is unsupported — even if it sounds plausible.

Safe for the public: never name secrets, tokens, database contents, private keys, private email addresses or credentials. Redact them with [REDACTED].

No uncontrolled artifacts: do not create any files, do not change anything, do not publish anything. The output is a draft until a human adopts it.

Run isolation: work only in {{ execution_path }}. If readiness_repo is set, the shell block measures that clone instead; there you only read. The commit under review is {{ workspace_source_sha }}.
author: MySuricates

defaultContext.public_angle: A living lab for controlled agentic development and self-improving workflow systems.

config.description: README verbatim plus a deterministic fact sheet
config.command:
set -uo pipefail
# Measured repository: the run's own clone, or the clone named in readiness_repo (read only).
R={{ execution_path }}
set -- {{ readiness_repo }}
case "${1:-}" in *'{{'*) set -- ;; esac
TARGET="${1:-}"
[ -n "$TARGET" ] && R="$TARGET"
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
cd "$R" || { echo 'gate_status: RED'; echo 'gate_category: public-claims'; echo 'gate_description: Working directory not reachable'; exit 0; }
if [ -n "$TARGET" ] && [ "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" != "$(pwd -P)" ]; then
  echo 'gate_status: RED'; echo 'gate_category: public-claims'
  echo 'gate_description: readiness_repo is not the root of a Git clone'; exit 0
fi
B=ai-automation-backend
F=ai-automation-frontend

echo '===== PART 1 — CLAIMS TO CHECK (README.de.md, verbatim) ====='
if [ -f README.de.md ]; then cat README.de.md; else echo 'README.de.md is missing'; fi

echo ''
echo '===== PART 2 — FACT SHEET (collected deterministically from the repository) ====='
echo "Collected on: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%d) UTC"
echo "Checked commit: $(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
if [ -n "$TARGET" ]; then echo 'Measured repository: public clone (readiness_repo)'; else echo 'Measured repository: working state of the run'; fi
echo "Commits in total: $(git rev-list --count HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
echo "First commit: $(git log --reverse --format=%ad --date=short 2>/dev/null | head -1)"
echo "Distinct author email addresses: $(git log --format='%ae' 2>/dev/null | sort -u | wc -l)"
echo ''
echo '--- Backend ---'
echo "REST controllers (*Controller.java): $(find $B/src/main/java -name '*Controller.java' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
echo "Flyway migrations: $(find $B/src/main/resources/db/migration -name 'V*.sql' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
echo "Highest migration number: $(find $B/src/main/resources/db/migration -name 'V*.sql' 2>/dev/null | sed 's#.*/V\([0-9]*\)__.*#\1#' | sort -n | tail -1)"
echo "Java lines in main (incl. blank and comment lines): $(find $B/src/main/java -name '*.java' -exec cat {} + 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
echo "Java test classes (*Test.java): $(find $B/src/test/java -name '*Test.java' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
echo "Block executor classes: $(find $B/src/main/java -path '*executor/blocks*' -name '*BlockExecutor.java' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
echo "Built-in templates (JSON): $(find $B/src/main/resources/templates/builtin -name '*.json' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
echo "Built-in skills (JSON files in src/main/resources/skills/builtin): $(find $B/src/main/resources/skills/builtin -name '*.json' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
echo "Integration providers (implements IntegrationProvider): $(grep -rl 'implements IntegrationProvider' $B/src/main/java 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
echo ''
echo '--- Frontend ---'
echo "TS/TSX lines in src (incl. tests): $(find $F/src \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) -exec cat {} + 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
echo "  of which in test files (*.test.ts/x): $(find $F/src \( -name '*.test.ts' -o -name '*.test.tsx' \) -exec cat {} + 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
echo "Frontend test files: $(find $F/src \( -name '*.test.ts' -o -name '*.test.tsx' \) 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
echo ''
echo '--- Versions (pom.xml, head) ---'
sed -n '1,45p' $B/pom.xml 2>/dev/null
echo ''
echo '--- Versions (package.json, excerpt) ---'
grep -E '"(react|typescript|vite|tailwindcss|zustand|@tanstack/react-query|vite-plugin-pwa)"' $F/package.json 2>/dev/null
echo ''
echo '--- Figures at the cut-off date of the README ("Stand YYYY-MM-DD") ---'
STAND=$(grep -oE 'Stand [0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' README.de.md 2>/dev/null | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f2)
SC=''
[ -n "$STAND" ] && SC=$(git rev-list -1 --before="${STAND}T23:59:59" HEAD 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "$STAND" ]; then
  echo 'No cut-off date found in the README — the figures above apply to HEAD.'
elif [ -z "$SC" ]; then
  echo "Cut-off date according to the README: $STAND — no commit found up to that day."
else
  echo "Cut-off date according to the README: $STAND"
  echo "Last commit up to the end of the cut-off date: $(git rev-parse --short "$SC")"
  echo "Commits up to the end of the cut-off date: $(git rev-list --count "$SC")"
  echo "Java lines in main at the cut-off date: $(git archive "$SC" $B/src/main/java 2>/dev/null | tar -x --to-stdout --wildcards '*.java' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
  echo "TS/TSX lines in src at the cut-off date (incl. tests): $(git archive "$SC" $F/src 2>/dev/null | tar -x --to-stdout --wildcards '*.ts' '*.tsx' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
fi
echo ''
echo '--- Getting started (TODO 1b84ecab) ---'
if grep -q 'providers_status' scripts/setup.sh 2>/dev/null && grep -q '^provider_logged_in()' scripts/lib/providers.sh 2>/dev/null; then
  echo 'Installer checks whether the AI CLIs are installed and logged in: yes (scripts/setup.sh step AI providers, provider_logged_in in scripts/lib/providers.sh)'
else
  echo 'Installer checks whether the AI CLIs are installed and logged in: no (no providers_status in scripts/setup.sh)'
fi
echo "Workflows in the example project (ExampleProjectService.EXAMPLE_TEMPLATE_IDS): $(grep -rh 'EXAMPLE_TEMPLATE_IDS = List.of(' $B/src/main/java 2>/dev/null | grep -o '"[^"]*"' | wc -l)"
echo ''
echo '===== PART 3 — NOT VERIFIABLE FROM THE REPOSITORY ====='
echo 'The following claims of the README refer to the operation of the running instance.'
echo 'Workflow shell blocks may read neither the database nor the REST API, so this run'
echo 'cannot check them. Classify them as a dated observation that has to be collected afresh'
echo 'before publication:'
echo 'The affected README lines, verbatim with line number:'
grep -nE '[0-9][*]*[[:space:]]*(Runs|Befunde)|^[|] Tests' README.de.md 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/  /'
echo 'The test figures come from a suite run; the fact sheet above only knows the number of'
echo 'test classes and test files, not the number of executed tests.'
exit 0

config.input:
Check every public claim of the README against the evidence.

The claims and the fact sheet are here:

{{ previous_output }}

Findings from the upstream evidence stage (may be empty if this workflow runs on its own — then ignore this section; if the unresolved placeholder name appears here instead of content, treat it as empty as well):

{{ previous_chain_output }}

---

Task:

1. Extract every checkable claim from PART 1 — especially the table of figures, the table of the four research questions, the section Reifegrad (maturity) and the tech stack. Phrases such as "runs daily", "never operated under load" or "the debts are counted" are claims too.
2. Check each one against PART 2. If the fact sheet is not enough, read in the repository and name the location. If the fact sheet names the public clone as the measured repository, it is at "{{ readiness_repo }}" — then read there, not in the working directory, which may be ahead of the clone.
   If the README names a cut-off date ("Stand YYYY-MM-DD"), compare commit and line counts with the section "Figures at the cut-off date" in PART 2, not with HEAD. Do not count yourself — the figures there are collected deterministically.
3. Classify claims from PART 3 as `dated` — neither as unsupported nor as supported.

The README is German: quote claims and write the safer wording and the new versions of README lines in German, everything else in English.

Output a table:

| # | Claim (verbatim, shortened) | Evidence with location | Classification | Safer wording |
|---|---|---|---|---|

Classifications: `supported`, `partially supported`, `unsupported`, `risky`, `dated`.
The column "Safer wording" stays empty for `supported` and is mandatory for everything else.

Then, under the heading "To change before publication", name the README lines that need to be adjusted, each with the old and the new version.

At the very end of the output there are exactly these three lines, each on its own, without indentation, without bullet points, without any other text before it on the same line:

gate_status: RED if a claim is risky, YELLOW if one is unsupported or partially supported, otherwise GREEN
gate_category: public-claims
gate_description: short reason in one sentence
